finding.comment: builder_ref must stay an immutable pin; floating it to a branch name would couple published images to unreviewed upstream state.

files.patch:
--- a/.github/workflows/publish.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/publish.yml
@@ -9,6 +9,6 @@
   image:
     uses: acme/infra-actions/.github/workflows/docker-build.yml@b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0
     with:
-      builder_ref: b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0
+      builder_ref: c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2
       platform: linux/amd64
